article.story: New Orleans Pelicans (6-14, 12th in the Western Conference) vs. Portland Trail Blazers (13-6, sixth in the Western Conference) Portland, Oregon; Sunday, 6 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Portland hosts New Orleans trying to continue its four-game home winning streak. The Trail Blazers are 11-5 against Western Conference opponents. Portland scores 116.7 points while outscoring opponents by 7.2 points per game. The Pelicans are 5-11 in Western Conference play. New Orleans has a 3-7 record in games decided by at least 10 points. The Trail Blazers average 116.7 points per game, 4.9 fewer points than the 121.6 the Pelicans give up. The Pelicans average 114.1 points per game, 4.6 more than the 109.5 the Trail Blazers allow. TOP PERFORMERS: Deni Avdija is shooting 51.3% and averaging 24.9 points for the Trail Blazers. Jrue Holiday is averaging 2.6 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. Jeremiah Fears is scoring 15.9 points per game and averaging 4.9 rebounds for the Pelicans. Saddiq Bey is averaging 2.5 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Trail Blazers: 7-3, averaging 114.4 points, 46.4 rebounds, 24.6 assists, 7.2 steals and 5.8 blocks per game while shooting 44.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 105.7 points per game. Pelicans: 2-8, averaging 107.6 points, 43.2 rebounds, 22.4 assists, 8.3 steals and 4.9 blocks per game while shooting 42.3% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 122.4 points. INJURIES: Trail Blazers: Chris Youngblood: out (heel), Damian Lillard: out (calf), Shaedon Sharpe: out (meniscus), Vit Krejci: out (leg), Ja Morant: out (hamstring). Pelicans: Dejounte Murray: out (ankle), Bennedict Mathurin: out (plantar). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
